name: phone_disconnect
description: Finish this agent's entire phone task: remove its activity indicator, UI ownership and pending notices. Call once as the final phone tool, including failure cleanup; never between individual calls or UI batches. Does not revoke credentials or affect other agents. For another batch in the same task use phone_end_ui instead. HTTP clients may then DELETE their own MCP session; do not make another tool call just to verify cleanup.

explanation.description: Optional brief user-facing explanation of what this call is doing and why, in the user's language (max 240 characters). Shown with the operation on the phone; do not include credentials, sensitive input or hidden reasoning. No separate notification call is needed.

name: phone_begin_ui
description: Acquire exclusive UI ownership on your EXISTING connection before reading or operating the screen. Declare your own client_name so the phone identifies the actual agent/task. Reuse this same session for all UI calls; do not initialize a new session for each batch. On ui_busy wait or report the conflict, never create another identity to bypass it. Ends explicitly or after 5 idle minutes; duration_seconds is ignored.

client_name.description: Your user-visible agent/task name, 1–40 characters, e.g. Codex 商品查询 or Hermes 日程助手. Persists on this owner until disconnect; does not change authorization or take over another agent. MCP clients should also declare clientInfo.name during initialize.

message.description: Short task goal shown in expanded status; no credentials or hidden reasoning.

name: phone_end_ui
description: Release only your CURRENT session's UI ownership after a batch or before waiting for manual user interaction. Keep this same connection for subsequent batches, assistance replies and non-UI work; call phone_begin_ui again before resuming UI. Does not disconnect the agent. Optionally show a completion message.

name: phone_notify_user
description: Show a message on the top overlay and in notifications. kind=help requests user assistance; the user can choose Done or Dismiss. Keep the returned notice_id to query their reply. Never infer that an assistance request has been completed.

name: phone_get_user_reply
description: Read the user's reply on the SAME session that created notice_id: pending/done/dismissed/expired/cancelled/not_found. Keep the connection while awaiting assistance, release UI during manual interaction, and poll at reasonable intervals rather than blocking or repeatedly reconnecting. A timeout is not completion.

name: phone_execute
description: Execute 1–20 bounded UI steps serially on your existing UI ownership (max 30 seconds). Each step {tool,arguments}; selectors are resolved afresh. Stops on first failed action/wait; returns receipts and final compact state. No shell, lifecycle, nested batches or arbitrary scripts. Reuse the same request_id for delivery recovery, not a new one.

name: phone_observe
description: Read target application UI on your current UI ownership. Choose backend for collection and mode for output; these are independent. Compact/text do not invent missing content. Coordinates are physical screen pixels; Accessibility node/snapshot IDs expire in 30 seconds. UiAutomation IDs are read-only and cannot be used for node actions.

limit.description: Output node budget, 1–600; filters apply before this limit. Response reports requested_limit/effective_limit; raw out-of-range requests are clamped.

mode.description: compact (default): useful visible nodes; text: same collection plus joined readable text; raw: diagnostic nodes including empty/invisible rows, still subject to budgets.

package_name.description: Accessibility: select a visible app window. UiAutomation: verify current root package; does not launch/switch apps.

include_system.description: Accessibility only: include system/overlay windows for diagnosis; UiAutomation rejects true.

changed_since.description: Accessibility delta against a same-owner/scope snapshot; UiAutomation always returns a full snapshot with reset=true.

fields.description: Project node fields to reduce output; geometry/identity safety fields remain.

backend.description: auto (default): prefer the fast Accessibility service, otherwise UiAutomation. accessibility: require that service; never silently switch. uiautomator: explicit privileged XML dump, slower (often seconds), requires authorized Shizuku/root; useful for comparison and missing text.

include_unimportant.description: Default true: include views Android marks unimportant, which may contain QQ/chat message text. false: filter them in Accessibility or use a compressed UiAutomation dump. Independent of mode; disabling can omit real content.

privilege_backend.description: UiAutomation executor only: auto (default), shizuku or root. Explicit choices fail if unavailable; ignored by auto when Accessibility is selected.
